name: knowhere
description: Personal Claude Code plugin marketplace for bruk-io projects

plugins.name: authoring-kit
plugins.description: For authoring Claude Code extensions (CLAUDE.md, rules, skills, subagents, hooks): skills for choosing the extension type and for the judgement in each, a linter that holds the checkable rules and the reference tables, a hook that delivers the matching rule on first touch and lints on write, and an auditor agent.

plugins.name: c4-architecture
plugins.description: Generate orthodox C4 architecture diagrams as LikeC4, extract C4 components from real codebases, and publish LikeC4 models as interactive Claude artifacts. Enforces Simon Brown's C4 rules that LikeC4 itself leaves unchecked.

plugins.name: philosophy
plugins.description: The standing constraints in every session and subagent, code and Python rules when a matching file is touched, and a self-running work loop following Anthropic's AI-native SDLC playbook: intent, spec, build and review as commands, with scripts that check the artefacts and make the build's mechanical calls.
